extra_context: We're a small residential architecture studio based in the Hudson Valley — I'm Nora, and I run it with two other architects. We design modern single-family homes and the occasional thoughtful renovation, mostly for clients who want something quiet and well-built, not flashy. The feeling I want the site to give is calm and confident, like walking into a finished house where every line is intentional. One thing that sets us apart: we walk the actual site at sunrise and sunset before we draw a single wall, so the house gets sited around the light rather than the other way around. The site should really just be the work — big photos of finished homes, lots of white space, our story kept short.
